title: The Descent of the Holy Spirit: Third Glorious Mystery
summary: Pray the Third Glorious Mystery page by page: the story of the Descent of the Holy Spirit, the Gospel, the decade prayers, and a quiet reflection.
keywords: the descent of the holy spirit

pages.title: The Descent of the Holy Spirit
pages.body: The apostles were gathered with Mary when a sound like a mighty wind filled the house, and tongues of fire rested on each of them. Filled with the Holy Spirit, they went out to tell everyone about Jesus. As we pray this decade, we ask the Holy Spirit for wisdom and brave hearts.
pages.imageAlt: El Greco's painting of Pentecost: the Holy Spirit descends like fire on Mary and the apostles.

evidence.claim: Original child-friendly meditation on the mystery; the mystery and its traditional day follow the standard Rosary order.

pages.title: From the Gospel
pages.body:
God's Word tells us this mystery. From the Acts of the Apostles, chapter 2 (Douay-Rheims Bible):

“And suddenly there came a sound from heaven, as of a mighty wind coming, and it filled the whole house where they were sitting. And there appeared to them parted tongues as it were of fire, and it sat upon every one of them: And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and they began to speak with divers tongues, according as the Holy Ghost gave them to speak.”

(Acts 2:1-4)

evidence.claim: Scripture quotation reproduced word for word from the Douay-Rheims 1899 American Edition (public domain); verse numbers omitted for reading aloud and ellipses mark skipped verses.

pages.title: Praying the Decade
pages.body:
We announce the mystery: The Descent of the Holy Spirit, the Third Glorious Mystery. Then we pray one decade of the Rosary, holding this scene in our hearts.

Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be Thy name; Thy kingdom come; Thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread; and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us; and lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen.

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen. (We pray the Hail Mary ten times, once for each bead of the decade.)

Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit; as it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

O my Jesus, forgive us our sins, save us from the fires of hell; lead all souls to Heaven, especially those in most need of Thy mercy.

evidence.claim: The Our Father, Hail Mary, Glory Be and Fatima prayers use the standard formulas printed across this site.

pages.title: The Fruit of This Mystery: Wisdom and apostolic boldness
pages.body:
This mystery grows the fruit of wisdom and apostolic boldness. The Spirit turned frightened friends into bold witnesses. What is one brave, kind thing the Spirit might be nudging you to do?

Let us pray: Holy Spirit, fill our hearts with your fire and your wisdom. Amen. Our Lady of the Rosary, pray for us.

evidence.claim: Original reflection and closing prayer; the fruit of the mystery follows the traditional list used across this site.
